verdict.rationale: Linear documents initiatives with lead teams, statuses, and priorities that show how work 'contributes to the broader direction', along with strategic roadmaps and project views. These suggest a native multi-project planning layer. However, no evidence explicitly shows initiatives grouping several projects or aggregating their progress into one portfolio view. The custom-dashboards item is a third-party integration, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that initiatives or roadmaps contain multiple projects, aggregated progress or roll-up metrics in a single portfolio view, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: You can now assign a team to lead an initiative, making it clear who is responsible for driving the work and how it contributes to the broader direction.
Priority communicates which initiatives are most important
Align your team with product initiatives, strategic roadmaps, and clear, up-to-date PRDs.
Added ability to subscribe to events in project views and receive notifications in Inbox or Slack
